title: Add runtime deployment topology for VPS-hosted Hermes API, gateway workers, project workspace access, logs, persistence, and health checks
summary: Define the production topology needed for the always-on remote operator service before live VPS deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: Topology names operator API, Discord gateway, Telegram gateway, and worker runner processes.
Persistence, workspace access, and health-check responsibilities are explicit.
The topology can be inspected from the Hermes CLI.
reviewNotes: Implemented remote_operator_deployment_topology and exposed it through hermes operator topology for VPS planning.
